title: Conference on Seerat-un-Nabiﷺ  Held at the Department of Islamic Studies, AWKUM
text:
The Department of Islamic Studies, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan organized a thought-provoking conference on
Seerat-un-Nabi
ﷺ

, in collaboration with the Provost Office AWKUM and the District Youth Office Mardan.
The conference focused on the theme:
اخلاقِ نبوی ﷺ کا حقیقی تصور اور انسانی عملی زندگی میں اس کی تطبیق
The renowned Islamic scholar
Mufti Sayed Shujat Ali Shah (Shaikhul Hadith Jamia Islamia Bubuzai Mardan)
graced the occasion as the Guest Speaker. He delivered profound insights into the philosophical, religious, and practical dimensions of the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) manners, emphasizing their relevance and applicability in contemporary human life.
The session was conducted under the supervision of Prof. Dr. Karim Dad, Chairperson, Department of Islamic Studies. Furthermore, the University Chief Proctor, nominees of the Provost Office, faculty members and students of the Department of Islamic Studies participated in the event. They showed keen interest in the lecture and appreciated the speaker’s scholarly and engaging presentation.
The conference concluded with a renewed commitment among attendees to incorporate the noble
اخلاقِ نبوی ﷺ

into their personal and social lives.
The convener Seminar/Workshop Committee Dr. Muhammad Zubair thanked the Vice Chancellor, Dean, Faculty of Arts & Humanities, Chairperson Department of Islamic Studies, Office of the Provost and Chief Proctor for their cordial support and assistant in conduction of the Seminar.
The Seminar ended with the distribution of shields among the organizers and the Guest Speaker, following by dua for the prosperity of the whole Muslim Ummah and University as well.
